title: Kill Postgres for 30 s — the audit path
expected: records buffered during the outage are not lost silently

unavailable_reasons:
InterfaceError: (sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql.asyncpg.InterfaceError) <class 'asyncpg.exceptions._base.InterfaceError'>: connection is closed
[SQL: 
    SELECT
        b.id
ConnectionRefusedError: [WinError 1225] The remote computer refused the network connection

notes: 2 audit records were discarded during the outage while 141 requests were still authorized. The emitter's max_retries path cannot tell a poison batch from an unreachable sink, so ADR-026's deny-on-full back-pressure never engaged. Counted, not silent — but a gap. See STATUS.md gap 20.
